name: Ogre Bodyguard
author: Johan Markström
description: A warband backed up by an Ogre makes a fearsome enemy, since Ogres are extremely dangerous fighters and a terrifying sight to behold when enraged.

abilities.name: Bodyguard
abilities.text: A fighter can make this reaction when a friendly `HERO` within 1" is targeted by an attack action. That attack action targets this fighter instead.

abilities.name: Whack
abilities.text: After this fighter's next melee attack action, if any damage was allocated to the target, it makes a free retreat action. You get to decide where it goes. For that retreat action the target may fly, however it cannot move vertically upwards more than 2" when doing so. Allocate (X/2) damage points to the target if it is touching an obstacle or another fighter at the end of the retreat action.
